act.songTitle: When an Old Cricketer Leaves the Crease
act.line: On the years of grace as those footsteps trace for the last time out of the act
stanza: When the moment comes and the gathering stands and the clock turns back to refl…
On the years of grace as those footsteps trace for the last time out of the act
Well this way of life's recollection, the hallowed strip in the haze
The fabled men and the noonday sun are much more than just yarns of their days

distract.line: Back to the fact that there's always something to distract
distract.linePrev: I pull out the plank and say, “Thank you for yanking me
distract.lineNext: But sometimes it's hard to know if I'm doing it right”

fact.line: That we have harbored based solely on the fact
stanza: Now we the American working population
Hate the fact that eight hours a day
Is wasted on chasing the dream of someone that isn't us
And we may not hate our jobs
But we hate jobs in general
That don't have to do with fighting our own causes
When we'd rather be supporting ourselves
By being paid to perfect the pastimes
That we have harbored based solely on the fact
That it makes us smile if it sounds dope
